tei:div.tei:p: gang zhig mtshan mor rgyu ba yi// 'byung po rnams dang sha za dang*// srin po sha rjen za ba dang*// sems can rnam pa sna tshogs pa// ljon shing gel pa sogs gnas dang*// de dang de la gtor ma ni// bza' ba sha chang la phug dang*// 'bras chen 'bras bu mang po yi// mchod sbyin 'di yis mgu byos la// gnod pa'i bsam pa zhi ba dang*// bdag cag rnams la phan pa'i yid// de ring phyin chad bskyed par gyis// rgyan gyis brgyan par byas kyang chos spyod cing*// dul zhing yang dag sdom la tshangs par spyod// 'byung po kun la chad pa spangs pa ste// dge slong dge sbyong de yin bram ze'ang de// mtshon chas mi 'jigs gang yang med// 'tsho ba'i srog la kun kyang 'dzems// rang gi lus la dpe longs la// gzhan la gnod pa ma byed cig /oṃ/ chen po'am chung ngu gang dag gi /lus la mngon par gnod gyur pa'i// nad de nye bar phyung nas su// gdon de rang gi gnas su dengs// de ltar bdag gis ci nus kyis// mchod dang bsnyen bkur byas pa yis// dam tshig la ni gnas nas su// rtag tu dam tshig la gnas shing*// 'dir ni sems can thams cad kyi// nad de rab tu sel mdzod la// gdon rnams rang gi gnas su dengs// zhes dang*/ na mo/ chos rnams sogs kyis chos sbyin byas la/ sarba bigh+nan gats+tshas gshegs shing*/ gang dag gdug cing rtsub pa'i sems 'chang ba thams cad 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du dengs shig /gal te mi 'gro na khro bo ye shes kyi rdo rje'i me rab tu 'bar ba 'dis khyod rang rnams kyi mgo bo tshal pa brgya tu 'gas par 'gyur ta re/ hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags bzlas te phyir khyer ro// sher snying srung 'khor bsgom/ sarba maṅga laṃ/// /
